name: Onna Kyoushi Chijoku no Senritsu
original_name: 女教師 恥辱の旋律
source:
Kasumi is a 25-year-old music teacher at a boys private school. During private lesson photo club member has a moment of passion with her and manages to make indecent photos of her body. That was the start of a long chain of atrocities and humiliations aimed at teacher.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
岛本香澄是私立男子学校二十五岁的音乐教师。一次私人指导中，摄影部成员对她一时冲动，成功拍下她身体的不雅照片。这是一连串针对教师的暴行与羞辱的开端。
